question: Q08-Kontext-Reparatur v2 (Hebel 4, Ticket 269d5101 neu bewertet): 40 Q08-Zeilen (23 INVALID 8.2 DSR_V2_MUTABLE_OR_RELATIVE_CONTEXT + 17 geparkt Q08_DSR_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE) haben Q02-Q07 bestanden und scheitern nur an fehlenden governed DSR-Inputs. recommendation: JA fuer (A), (C), (D) jetzt; (B) Rebuilds ueber Aequivalenzregel, Sweep-Arme als Folgekarte.
yes_effect: Q08_CONTEXT_REPAIR_V2=ACTIVE: governed card amendment (append-only qm-dsr-single-configuration block, both card locations, card sha re-bound, journal) for the 24 class-A EAs; regenerate the 4 baseline set files; append-only Q08 reruns with QM_Q08_DSR_CONTEXT_PREFLIGHT=1 for classes A and C; class D rows disposed SUPERSEDED; class B: 41472/41473/41474 bound to the original cards via the identity-equivalence proofs, the 7 winsweep arms + 12115 parked WINSWEEP_ARM_Q08_CONTEXT_PENDING with a follow-up card.
